messages:
ana: seeing a spike of 503s from hosted us-east-1 across multiple customers, gateway shows upstream worker crashes
mike: which customers + any reproducible pattern?
ana: acme-prod and a few internal smoke runs. Happens on auth-heavy bursts, looks like the infer-runner dies and container restarts. Logs: 
```
ERROR infer-runner: signal 11 (SIGSEGV) at 0x7f3a2c4b
2024-02-07T15:02:10Z GPU0: cudart: out of memory allocating 1.1 GiB
PID 3421 exited with code 139
```
leo: segfault after OOM in logs — might be allocator double-free on OOM path. Any recent quant/model swaps?
ana: we did a quant swap to gpt-large-quant yesterday morning. Throttle config unchanged. Repro steps I'm running: 1) hit /v1/generate with 8-10k context; 2) auth QPS ~25-30k; 3) observe runner mem climb then crash. Sample request attached below.
mike: can you paste the exact request body you used? need to reproduce locally.
ana: sample: `{"model":"gpt-large-quant","input":"<~9k tokens>","max_tokens":512,"stream":false}`
jamie: saw similar after toolcall-heavy bursts — allocator racing with KV cache prefetch. Any toolcalls in these requests?
nana: not in this particular repro, pure generation. Also saw a coredump uploaded to the bucket: s3://internal-cores/3421/core.gz
cs-rep: customers are reporting timeouts and 503s, CS escalations coming in. ETA to mitigate?
nana: mitigation implemented: temporarily limit max_concurrent_contexts per GPU (rolled out to us-east-1), and enabled routing fallback to dedicated pool for affected routes. Initial impact: error rate down from ~14% -> ~3%.
mike: created INC ticket INC-20240207-0034 and linked the core + logs. Adding heaptrace and gdb output.
leo: quick triage notes: 1) OOM triggers segfault in allocator cleanup path 2) quant runtime has different allocator behavior 3) env var MALLOC_ARENA_MAX was changed in the last deploy?
jamie: can we add a defensive check: if GPU allocation fails, catch + return 429/503 gracefully without hitting the segfault path? Might be safer than restart.
mike: plan for next 48h: 1) add allocation guard + improved OOM handling on runtime hotpath 2) reproduce locally with exact model + context + auth-burst tooling 3) add CI load test for auth-burst pattern 4) collect more cores and enable less-aggressive restart policy 5) customer comms draft (cs-rep)
cs-rep: drafting customer note — will say investigation ongoing, mitigation applied, temporary routing in place, ETA 48h for remediation.
incident-bot: incident INC-20240207-0034 created and assigned to oncall-sre
ana: repro attempt in lab: reproduced with a script that simulates token validation latency + continuous long-context requests. Uploaded script to internal gist: http://internal/gists/auth-burst-repro.sh
leo: thanks — grabbing the core and running addr2line. If we can get a minimal repro that hits OOM deterministically we can test the allocation guard.
jamie: deployed temporary patch to check return code from cudaMalloc and short-circuit to CPU path; rolling patch to canary now.
mike: roll to 10% canary in us-east-1 — monitoring.
ana: update: canary looks good for 15m, no crashes on canary machines, error rate stable ~1.8%
cs-rep: passing update to impacted customers, they asked for postmortem when fixed.
leo: follow-ups: postmortem, add auth-burst synthetic in perf tests, revert risky allocator changes if they were part of the swap, and add metrics for GPU alloc failures.
mike: filing follow-up tasks and will own the postmortem write-up. Thanks team :thumbsup:
cs-rep: customers want timeline for a permanent fix — proposing 48 hours after full repro + patch verification.
nana: noted, updating the incident with runbook and links.
